rules.description: The primary ink for typography across the site, establishing a sharp, high-contrast aesthetic.
The foundational surface and background color, providing a stark, minimalist canvas that lets product imagery stand out.

Reversed typography and icons in the dark footer
Faint ghost buttons in the footer (#ffffff0d)

rules.description: The brand's deliberate 'Pure Black', applied to heavy surface areas and primary interface components to create deep contrast.

insights: The brand relies on an ultra-minimalist, monochromatic design system, stripping away color entirely to let product hardware imagery take center stage.
Translucency is a foundational structural tool, utilizing semi-transparent white fills to create frosted glass product cards that overlay seamlessly onto background photography.
The palette subtly distinguishes between a strict #000000 for global document text and a deliberate #040404 ('pure-black') for heavy UI surfaces like the footer and primary buttons.
